reason: This report derives PRIMARY ENERGY FACTORS for energy systems. Its tables are overviews of which ecoinvent datasets are used (Tab. 2.1, 2.4, 2.10, 2.18, 2.24, 3.1-3.3, 4.1-4.2), heating-value conversions, technology mixes and per-MJ Sachbilanz tables of fuels as they are USED (diesel in a lorry, petrol in a car, natural gas in a car, Tab. 2.11-2.17), plus district-heat and electricity-mix data. None of the 43 captions gives the exchanges of long-distance natural gas pipeline transport per tkm, so this dataset's inventory is not documented here.
